_about: Settings for the page survey and checker (build/watch/survey.py). user_agent: how the checker introduces itself to websites. timeout_s: how long to wait for a page. delay_s: the pause between two pages on the same site, so no site gets more than one request at a time. workers: how many different sites are fetched at once. min_text_chars: a page with less visible text than this is probably built by JavaScript and needs a browser. manual_hosts: sites that block automatic checking (checked by hand). out_dir: where the reports go, relative to the repo root. sources_file: the rules for checking records (src/sources.csv). manual_methods / browser_methods: words in a rule's method that mean it's done by hand (not fetched) or needs a real browser. default_recheck: the recheck interval given to proposed rules.
user_agent: SignpostingSomersetChecker/0.1 (+https://signpostingsomerset.org.uk; checks that listed services' pages haven't changed)
